message.content:
The task was to compare the maximum number of private repositories allowed in GitHub Free and Pro plans.

The result response states that both GitHub Free and GitHub Pro allow unlimited private repositories. The screenshot supports this at least for GitHub Free, showing GitHub Docs text saying Free includes “unlimited private repositories,” and it also shows the GitHub Pro section beginning with “In addition to the features available with GitHub Free…,” which reasonably supports that Pro includes the Free plan’s unlimited private repositories. The response also cites GitHub Pricing and GitHub Docs, though the screenshot itself is from GitHub Docs rather than the pricing page.

Overall, the requested comparison was provided clearly: both plans allow unlimited private repositories, so neither has a fixed maximum.

Verdict: SUCCESS
